title: [pagination]: show `<<, <, >, >>` by default (even when not clickable), provide an option to hide them
body: One issue with the current implementation is that when we automatically hide the `<<, <, >, >>` if not needed. This might be a problem in some implementations where the user do not want this behavior. What we can do: * when not needed, render `<<, <, >, >>` without a wrapper `` (so, not a link) * provide an option (`autoHideNavigation`) to automatically hide them (visibility:hidden to maintain horizontal space, we still need to render them).
